biw_news.title: VW Group Scalable Systems Platform Delays Push Audi A4 E-Tron to 2029
biw_news.summary: Continued delays in Volkswagen Group's next-generation Scalable Systems Platform (SSP) have forced Audi to postpone production of its electric A4 replacement to March 2029. The unified EV architecture is intended to standardize chassis structural design and software integration across multi-brand vehicle segments.

biw_news.title: Maserati and JAC Partner on Next-Gen Electric GT and SUV Platform Strategy
biw_news.summary: Maserati is restructuring its electric vehicle platform manufacturing by pairing with JAC for structural manufacturing and Huawei software tech before final assembly in Italy. The platform realignment targets upcoming large GT and SUV electric vehicle architectures.

biw_news.title: Aston Martin DB12 S Implements 50kg Mass Reduction for Dynamic Enhancement
biw_news.summary: Aston Martin's newly unveiled DB12 S super tourer incorporates structural lightweighting techniques that shed up to 50kg from the vehicle platform. The engineering focus delivers a higher power-to-weight ratio and improved torsional dynamics for track-oriented performance.

biw_news.title: McLaren to Phase Out Core Mid-Engine Platforms Ahead of Next-Gen Architecture
biw_news.summary: McLaren plans to retire the Artura, GTS, and 750S model lines by 2028 as part of a major structural transition to a new supercar platform and SUV architecture. The upcoming structural design will accommodate advanced hybrid powertrains and refreshed carbon-tub layouts.

biw_news.title: UK Vehicle Production Bolstered by McLaren Factory and Nissan Platform Investments
biw_news.summary: New capital injections into McLaren's body manufacturing capabilities and Nissan's Sunderland plant provide critical support to UK vehicle assembly lines. However, industry experts emphasize that broader transition timelines to dedicated EV body-in-white structures remain sluggish.

biw_news.title: Sixth-Generation Toyota RAV4 Platform Optimizes Plug-in Hybrid Battery Integration
biw_news.summary: The sixth-generation Toyota RAV4 features an updated platform architecture designed specifically to streamline plug-in hybrid system packaging and chassis reinforcement. The structural modifications accommodate larger battery capacity while preserving cabin volume and structural crash performance.
